newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Gas buys Teco pipeline for $380 million.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Gas buys Teco pipeline for $380 million.

text.p: Pacific Gas Transmission Co., a unit of Pacific Gas & Electric Co., Wednesday said it will acquire Teco Pipeline Co. for $380 million.

Teco is primarily owned by TRT Holdings Inc. of Corpus Christie, Texas, Pacific Gas said. Teco owns a 500 mile pipeline system in Texas, and has investments in other gas gathering and processing facilities. It also owns a gas marketing firm, Pacific Gas said.
Houston-based Pacific Gas' stock edged down 12.5 cents to $23.875 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
